packageRules.description: Group all non-major updates into a single PR
openapi-typescript 7.x needs the TypeScript 5 JS API (peer ^5.x); TypeScript 6+/7 breaks api-types generation. Remove this rule once openapi-typescript supports a newer TypeScript
Python interpreter (.python-version, Docker image, requires-python): bump it by hand once Vercel's Python runtime supports the new version
